from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import copy
import hashlib
import json
import pathlib
import sys


parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Qualify complete archived-source extraction evidence and rejection controls")
parser.add_argument("--evidence-root", type=pathlib.Path, default=pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent)
parser.add_argument("--repository", type=pathlib.Path, required=True)
parser.add_argument("--source-root", type=pathlib.Path)
args = parser.parse_args()
BASE = args.evidence_root.resolve(strict=True)
REPO = args.repository.resolve(strict=True)
SOURCE = (args.source_root or BASE / "qualification-source").resolve(strict=True)
sys.path.insert(0, str(REPO / "artifact"))
import codeql_rust_quality as q


def decoded(name):
    return json.loads((BASE / ("qualified-" + name + ".json")).read_text())["#select"]["tuples"]


q.REPOSITORY_ROOT = SOURCE
tracked = frozenset(path.relative_to(q.REPOSITORY_ROOT).as_posix() for path in q.REPOSITORY_ROOT.rglob("*.rs"))
extracted = q._parse_extracted_paths(decoded("ExtractedPaths"))
metrics, files, diagnostics = q._parse_quality_rows(decoded("Metrics"))
unresolved = q._parse_unresolved_macros(decoded("UnresolvedMacros"))
evidence = [tracked, extracted, metrics, files, list(diagnostics), list(unresolved)]
q.validate_current_and_archive_quality(*evidence)
controls = []


def rejection(name, changed):
    try:
        q.validate_current_and_archive_quality(*changed)
    except q.CodeQLRustQualityError as exc:
        controls.append({"control": name, "outcome": "rejected", "error": str(exc)})
    else:
        raise AssertionError("accepted negative control: " + name)


try:
    q.validate_quality(tracked, extracted, metrics)
except q.CodeQLRustQualityError as exc:
    original_failure = str(exc)
else:
    raise AssertionError("original gate unexpectedly admitted partial archives")

archive = sorted(q.pinned_archive_sources(q.REPOSITORY_ROOT))[0]
current = sorted(extracted)[0]
changed = copy.deepcopy(evidence)
del changed[3][archive]
rejection("missing archive extraction", changed)
changed = copy.deepcopy(evidence)
changed[1] = extracted - {current}
rejection("missing current successful extraction", changed)
changed = copy.deepcopy(evidence)
changed[2]["unresolved_source_macro_calls"] += 1
changed[5].append((current, 1, 1, "assert!..."))
rejection("unresolved current macro", changed)
changed = copy.deepcopy(evidence)
row = list(changed[4][0]); row[2] = "parse_error"; changed[4][0] = tuple(row)
rejection("archive warning with different tag", changed)
changed = copy.deepcopy(evidence)
row = list(changed[4][0]); row[4] += " changed"; changed[4][0] = tuple(row)
rejection("archive warning with different full message", changed)
changed = copy.deepcopy(evidence)
changed[4].pop(); changed[2]["extraction_warnings"] -= 1
rejection("missing archive diagnostic", changed)
changed = copy.deepcopy(evidence)
row = list(changed[4][0]); row[1] = "Error"; changed[4][0] = tuple(row)
changed[2]["extraction_warnings"] -= 1; changed[2]["extraction_errors"] += 1
rejection("archive extraction error", changed)
changed = copy.deepcopy(evidence)
changed[2]["unextracted_elements"] += 1
rejection("unextracted element", changed)
changed = copy.deepcopy(evidence)
for path in extracted:
    changed[3][path] = (0, changed[3][path][1])
changed[2]["source_macro_calls"] = sum(counts[0] for counts in changed[3].values())
rejection("archive macros cannot supply current sentinel", changed)
source = q.REPOSITORY_ROOT / archive
original = source.read_bytes()
try:
    source.write_bytes(original + b"\n")
    rejection("changed archive source bytes", evidence)
finally:
    source.write_bytes(original)
manifest = source.parent / "Cargo.toml"
assert not manifest.exists()
try:
    manifest.write_text('[package]\nname="unexpected"\nversion="0.1.0"\n')
    rejection("Cargo manifest above archive source", evidence)
finally:
    manifest.unlink()
q.validate_current_and_archive_quality(*evidence)
record = {
    "tool": "CodeQL 2.26.2",
    "tool_bundle_sha256": "0b152b004dec9fd57ccaf58d3fc410efa5be409e1b331cde280b0b8db7bc6dd6",
    "rustc": "1.94.0 (4a4ef493e 2026-03-02)",
    "source": "two current Cargo probe modules and all 68 exact archived Rust files with the original five manifests",
    "original_gate": {"outcome": "rejected", "error": original_failure},
    "current_gate": "pass",
    "extracted_files": len(files),
    "successfully_extracted_current_files": len(extracted),
    "archived_files": len(tracked - extracted),
    "current_macro_calls": sum(files[path][0] for path in extracted),
    "current_format_args": sum(files[path][1] for path in extracted),
    "global_metrics": metrics,
    "query_sha256": {name: hashlib.sha256((REPO / "artifact/codeql-rust-quality" / (name + ".ql")).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for name in ("ExtractedPaths", "Metrics", "UnresolvedMacros")},
    "result_sha256": {name: hashlib.sha256((BASE / ("qualified-" + name + ".json")).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for name in ("ExtractedPaths", "Metrics", "UnresolvedMacros")},
    "rejection_controls": controls,
}
(BASE / "QUALIFICATION.json").write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + "\n")
print(json.dumps(record, indent=2))

replay.py.utf8:
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
import pathlib
import subprocess
import sys
import time

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Replay the pinned paper-archive CodeQL experiment")
parser.add_argument("--fixture", type=pathlib.Path, required=True)
parser.add_argument("--repository", type=pathlib.Path, required=True)
parser.add_argument("--output", type=pathlib.Path, required=True)
parser.add_argument("--codeql", type=pathlib.Path)
parser.add_argument("--rust-bin", type=pathlib.Path)
parser.add_argument("--prepare-only", action="store_true")
args = parser.parse_args()
spec = json.loads(args.fixture.read_text())
repo = args.repository.resolve(strict=True)
out = args.output.absolute()
out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
source = out / "qualification-source"
source.mkdir()


def checked_bytes(record, data):
    if len(data) != record["bytes"] or hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() != record["sha256"]:
        raise ValueError("fixture bytes differ: " + record["path"])
    path = pathlib.PurePosixPath(record["path"])
    if path.is_absolute() or ".." in path.parts or path.as_posix() != record["path"]:
        raise ValueError("fixture path is not canonical")
    return path


for record in spec["probe_files"] + spec["archive_manifests"]:
    data = record["utf8"].encode("utf-8")
    path = checked_bytes(record, data)
    target = source / path
    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    target.write_bytes(data)
for record in spec["archive_sources"]:
    data = (repo / record["path"]).read_bytes()
    path = checked_bytes(record, data)
    target = source / path
    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    target.write_bytes(data)
for name, digest in spec["query_sha256"].items():
    path = repo / "artifact/codeql-rust-quality" / (name + ".ql")
    if hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest() != digest:
        raise ValueError("query source differs: " + name)
qualifier = spec["scripts"]["qualify.py"]
data = qualifier["utf8"].encode("utf-8")
if len(data) != qualifier["bytes"] or hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() != qualifier["sha256"]:
    raise ValueError("qualification script differs")
(out / "qualify.py").write_bytes(data)
if args.prepare_only:
    print("Prepared two current Rust modules, four Cargo probe files, 68 archives and five original manifests.")
    raise SystemExit(0)
if args.codeql is None or args.rust_bin is None:
    raise ValueError("--codeql and --rust-bin are required for execution")
codeql = args.codeql.resolve(strict=True)
rust_bin = args.rust_bin.resolve(strict=True)
env = os.environ.copy()
env["PATH"] = str(rust_bin) + os.pathsep + env["PATH"]
if subprocess.check_output([str(codeql), "version", "--format=terse"], env=env, text=True).strip() != "2.26.2":
    raise ValueError("CodeQL version differs")
if subprocess.check_output([str(rust_bin / "rustc"), "--version"], env=env, text=True).strip() != spec["tool_identity"]["rustc"]:
    raise ValueError("Rust version differs")
sysroot = subprocess.check_output([str(rust_bin / "rustc"), "--print", "sysroot"], env=env, text=True).strip()
env["CODEQL_EXTRACTOR_RUST_OPTION_SYSROOT"] = sysroot
env["CODEQL_EXTRACTOR_RUST_OPTION_SYSROOT_SRC"] = sysroot + "/lib/rustlib/src/rust/library"
env["CARGO_TARGET_DIR"] = str(out / "qualification-target")
commands = []


def run(name, command, deadline):
    start = time.monotonic()
    with (out / (name + ".log")).open("w") as log:
        result = subprocess.run(command, env=env, stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, timeout=deadline)
    commands.append({"stage": name, "command": command, "returncode": result.returncode,
                     "elapsed_seconds": time.monotonic() - start})
    (out / "replay-commands.json").write_text(json.dumps(commands, indent=2) + "\n")
    if result.returncode:
        raise subprocess.CalledProcessError(result.returncode, command)


database = out / "qualification-database"
run("qualification-extraction", [str(codeql), "database", "create", str(database),
    "--language=rust", "--build-mode=none", "--source-root=" + str(source), "--threads=2", "--ram=4096"], 600)
for name in ("ExtractedPaths", "Metrics", "UnresolvedMacros"):
    bqrs = out / ("qualified-" + name + ".bqrs")
    run("qualified-" + name, [str(codeql), "query", "run", "--warnings=error", "--threads=4",
        "--ram=14000", "--database=" + str(database), "--output=" + str(bqrs), "--",
        str(repo / "artifact/codeql-rust-quality" / (name + ".ql"))], 300)
    result = subprocess.check_output([str(codeql), "bqrs", "decode", "--format=json", str(bqrs)], env=env, timeout=300)
    (out / ("qualified-" + name + ".json")).write_bytes(result)
run("qualification", [sys.executable, str(out / "qualify.py"), "--repository", str(repo),
    "--source-root", str(source), "--evidence-root", str(out)], 300)
print((out / "QUALIFICATION.json").read_text())

entrypoint: Materialize scripts.replay.py.utf8 outside the checkout, then run python3 replay.py --fixture <this JSON> --repository <normal checkout> --output <new directory> --codeql <verified 2.26.2 binary> --rust-bin <1.94.0 toolchain bin directory>. --prepare-only verifies and materializes the fixture without executing CodeQL.
